taskReuseDecisionAcceptance.reasoning: Accept retained selected-cargo scene plus the specific KEAP1/CUL3–NRF2 condition inset. Generic tagging/destruction art does not name the regulator/substrate or changed-turnover relation. The inset adds those identities and two conditions without redrawing another proteasome or a universal release latch.

scientificAssessment.reasoning: The Zhang primary abstract supports KEAP1 adaptor function in a CUL3 complex and reduced NRF2 ubiquitination under tested stress conditions without loss of KEAP1–NRF2 association. Independent ubiquitin and proteasome abstracts support the retained E1/E2/E3, cargo unfolding and ubiquitin-recycling distinctions. Matching regulators and substrates in both panels, together with the explicit caption, avoid construing the dashed arrow as physical release or synthesis. The page does not infer NRF2 dependence or ferroptosis sensitivity from abundance or a CUL3 finding.
